name: UNTIL is inclusive and is compared as an instant
note: A Monday 09:00 series from 2026-03-02 with UNTIL=20260316T130000Z. Mar 2 is EST (UTC-5), so 09:00 local is 14:00Z. America/New_York enters DST on 2026-03-08, so Mar 9 and Mar 16 are EDT (UTC-4) and 09:00 local is 13:00Z. The UNTIL instant equals the Mar 16 occurrence exactly, and UNTIL is inclusive, so Mar 16 is kept and the series stops there.
